newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Edegel sets cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Edegel sets cash dividend.

text.p: Peruvian electricity generator Edegel agreed a cash dividend of 0.1326 sol per share with a Sept. 4 record date and a Sept. 10 payout date, according to a Lima Stock Exchange report.
The dividend, based on profits so far this year and also in 1995, will correspond to 366.78 million Class A shares and 244.52 million Class B shares.
The dividend per share is based on 0.036605 sol for 1995 profits, and 0.095995 sol for profits so far in 1996, the market's daily report added.
